dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped patterns across the dorsal-lateral surface. Prominent mid-dorsal annulus exhibits a thin, irregular dark perimeter with a sharp gradient shift to a light-grey interior. Posterior structures show more fragmented, 'C' shaped geometries with jagged, high-contrast boundaries. Anterior neck-region annuli are tightly circular with well-defined dark outer edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of low-intensity (dark) solid pixel clusters interspersed between larger annuli. High-intensity (white/pale) patches are concentrated in the lower anterior region and facial area, lacking internal gradients and appearing as solid-tone segments.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest dorsal annuli form an elongated obtuse triangle. A secondary grouping of four smaller dark blobs in the posterior region forms a localized quadrilateral cluster with narrow internal angles.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent high-contrast vibrissae extending from the muzzle, visible as distinct linear pixel-wide paths against the darker background.
